title: helia splendens
intro: Helia splendens, commonly known as Heliotropium splendens, is a plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Helia splendens include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the pharmacological effects of Helia splendens and its potential applications in modern medicine.
